title: Six Is Minimal: Exact Certification and Infinite Families of Stable Nonclique CTLNs
description:
Unrefereed computer-assisted mathematical candidate. In nondegenerate legal CTLNs with uniform positive drive, the minimum stable nonclique support size is exactly six. Exact integer-polynomial obstructions cover all graph classes through five vertices over the whole legal parameter domain. The six-neuron graph is prior work by Geneson. Further certificates give its full-support phase region and an explicit family on 5r+6 vertices with size-dependent parameters and shrinking stability margin.

Version 1.1 addresses the supplied AI-generated review: expanded antecedent comparison, explicit non-uniform margin, parameter-choice rationale and read-only replay. Original prose and data are CC0-1.0; original code is MIT. No external human peer review, formal verification, unaffiliated reproduction, exhaustive priority or biological validation is claimed.
